title: CloudWatch alarms and billing alarms

kcs.statement: A CloudWatch alarm watches one metric against a threshold over a set number of evaluation periods and moves between the OK, ALARM and INSUFFICIENT_DATA states.

An alarm action can send a notification, scale an Auto Scaling group, or stop, terminate, reboot or recover an EC2 instance; a billing alarm on estimated charges warns when spending passes a set amount.

problem_ideas: Alarm: CPU > 80% for 3 consecutive 5-minute periods. Given readings 85, 90, 70, 88, 92, 95, predict the state after each period.
An alarm was just created and the instance is stopped: which state will it show?
A student wants an email if their AWS bill passes $10: which alarm type and which metric?
Scale out when average CPU stays above 70% for 10 minutes: which two services work together?
An instance fails a system status check at 3 a.m.: which alarm action brings it back without a human?
How soon can an alarm fire with 2 evaluation periods under basic monitoring, compared with detailed monitoring?
